events.title: Train to Jaipur
events.details: Ajmer Shatabdi (12015) from NDLS, arrives at Jaipur Jn at 10:40.

events.title: Check in at Alsisar Haveli
events.details: Rest in restored Rajput heritage suites.

events.title: City Palace & Jantar Mantar
events.details: Old City cluster — royal courtyards and ancient astronomical instruments. Stop by Lassiwala on MI Road.

events.title: Hawa Mahal Facade & Johari Bazaar
events.details: Illuminated Palace of Winds and traditional textile shopping.

events.title: Amer Fort & Palace
events.details: Amer cluster — massive hilltop fortress overlooking Maota Lake. Enjoy authentic Dal Baati Churma lunch nearby.

events.title: Jaigarh Fort & Cannon Viewpoint
events.details: Views of the Aravalli hills and the world's largest wheeled cannon.

events.title: Jal Mahal Sunset View
events.details: Scenic twilight photo stop at the Water Palace.

events.title: Train to New Delhi
events.details: Shatabdi Express (12016), arrives at New Delhi (NDLS) at 22:30.
